task: Look for the largest hunting land for auction in Kansas high plain region with mineral rights posted in the last seven days.
agent_final_answer: No matching listing exists - the task is impossible. On LandWatch, the High Plains Region of Kansas filtered by Property Type = Hunting and Date Listed = Past 7 days returns 0 listings. (The only property types posted in the last 7 days in that region were House (9), Undeveloped (2), Horse (1), Farms and Ranches (1), Homesite (1), and Commercial (1) - no Hunting listings at all.) There is only ONE hunting-property auction in the entire High Plains Kansas region: a 157.38-acre tract at 3122 County Road 378, Hill City, KS (Graham County), listed by Jeff Moon / AgWest Land Brokers, online auction bidding June 4-11, 2026. But that listing was last updated May 1, 2026 - more than 7 days before today (June 3, 2026) - so it does NOT qualify as posted in the last seven days, and its description/amenities make no mention of mineral rights either. Adding the Auction sale type and the Mineral Rights feature to the Hunting + Past 7 days filter also yields 0 listings. Therefore there is no largest (or any) hunting land for auction in the Kansas High Plains region with mineral rights posted in the last seven days.
